services.desc: Light tackle mooching is our specialty! Mooching is a local technique where you will hold the rod, feel the bite, and set the hook yourself. We prefer this method because it’s an active experience. Where trollers are stationary, looking at their rods all day and almost always sharing a fishing rod, on our Seattle fishing charter boat, you will actively work the bait at different depths to maximize your experience. This type of fishing is intended for those who like to cast, hold their own rod and hook, and feel the fish bite. Anyone can mooch; you don’t have to have years of experience or high skill levels to try this technique. This method means you’re not sitting around on the boat all

services.name: Seattle Boat Tours
services.desc: Each day is different on the water. Rich with marine mammal and bird life, you never know what you might see. On any day, one might see an orca, gray, or humpback whale. Porpoises, harbor seals, sea lions or, even, a rare elephant seal could appear. Eagles can be seen fishing, sea gulls diving in the middles of huge balls of herring, and, rhinoceros auklets and cormorants could show up. Looking south, on a clear day, Mt. Rainier looms; To the north, Mt. Baker; To the west, The Olympic Mountains and to the east, The Cascades. What a place this is! I can design a tour that highlights what you are most interested in, or just take you to some of my favorite islands and inlets that I’ve visited
